# sdx-store-app

Original synthetic code written for this repository. It contains no third-party code or assets and is released under the repository license.

## Purpose

A SharpDX Toolkit project whose `ProjectTypeGuids` include the Windows Store app type. MonoGame desktop cannot host it, so the analyzer must report it as unsupported. It is never built.

## What the analyzer should find

- A Toolkit project.
- A blocker for the Windows Store or Windows Phone project type.
